Class PersistenceService

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.network.server.PersistenceService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class PersistenceService extends Object implements Runnable
A background service that periodically saves the state of active matches to a JSON backup file, enabling game recovery after server crashes.
